FUTU.excerpt: EX-99.1 2 tm2629883d1_ex99-1.htm EXHIBIT 99.1 Exhibit 99.1 Futu Announces Third Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results HONG KONG, November 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Futu Holdings Limited (“Futu” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: FUTU), a leading tech-driven online brokerage and wealth management platform, today announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Operational Highlights · Total number of funded accounts 1 increased 27.9% year-over-year to 4,005,858 as of September 30, 2026. · Total number of brokerage accounts 2 increased 22.5% year-over-year to 6,868,829 as of September 30, 2026. · Total number of users 3 increased 13.8% year-over-year to 32.0 million as of September 30, 2026. · Total client assets increased 7.6% year-over-year to HK$1.33 trillion as of September 30, 2026. · Daily average client assets were HK$1.33 trillion in the third quarter of 2026, an increase of 21.1% from the same period in 2025. · Total trading volume in the third quarter of 2026 increased by 28.4% year-over-year to HK$5.01 trillion, in which trading volume for U.S. stocks was HK$3.81 trillion, and trading volume for Hong Kong stocks was HK$942.5 billion. · Margin financing and securities lending balance increased 17.1% year-over-year to HK$73.8 billion as of September 30, 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights · Total revenues increased 4.5% year-over-year to HK$6,690.6 million (US$852.7 million). · Total gross profit was largely stable year-over-year to HK$5,630.5 million (US$717.6 million). · Net income was largely stable year-over-year to HK$3,186.7 million (US$406.1 million). · Non-GAAP adjusted net income⁴ was largely stable year-over-year to HK$3,272.4 million (US$417.0 million).
